senses.gloss: (sec. r. of סבב), Pa. סַיֵּיב [to go all around,] to finish up, trim.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 78">Gen. R. s. 78</cite> (a proverbial expression) <he>שייצת סַיְּיבַת</he> hast thou finished? hast thou trimmed (so as to be entitled to wages)?; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 133:2">Yalk. ib. 133</cite> <he>סייפת</he>.
